notes.title: Patch notes 0.7.0
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22961750/8b2cee546efd6a44f3ec05a535a310f512cde5da.png

Main Features:

- Added tutorial. This tutorial is supposed to show you the basics of the game. It will start on the first launch of game after it's updated.

- Added Madness Mode (MM). The MM is feature that makes your game graduating to the end. There are 17 events such as "Time Speed Up" or "Electrovision". These events will be unlocked after you reach the required level. Combinating more events at once becomes more expensive (Madness Points).

- Madness Points (MP) are a currency for Madness Mode. Basically it's your capacity how big Madness you can create. These points are reusable so they are not for only for one use. You can gain MP by leveling up or as a reward for completing Missions. You can save your own combination/settings of Madness mode to file so you can easily save/load the option for your future games. (file manager is pretty shitty but we must wait when we iterate it >> find a better solution)

- Reworked Missions. Missions have finally a proper purpose now. There are about 22 unique scaling Missions (in summary about 99 missions) and each of them has its suitable reward - Experience and Madness points (there should be a little bit more of them later for other planned feature).

- Reworked Achievements. We are sorry for everyone that lose the old achievements but in case of compatibilty we had to remove them but don't worry. This change shouldn't happen again (in 99%). On the other hand now we have more achievements than before and actually we can add new ones if we get some good ideas.

- Reworked Experience/Level System. There's another The good and The bad side. The bad thing might be we reset the system because we totally changed the scale and algorithm how fast or slow you level up now. Once again, on the other hand it should be more stable and balanced. Additionaly for every level up you get Madness Points as a reward.

Graphics

- Removed old glow
- Added HDR option + Bloom
- Added Depth Of Field
- Added FXAA Antialiasing
- New 3D menu scene
- Redone loading screens
- Some color tweaks used in menu (kind of a test for planned gui rework)
- Redone GUI of missions
- Highlighted player's bar in score table
- Added indication of madness events on right side

Technical

- Improved AI of bots. We know it's still quite bad but atleast they kill eachother less than before

Others

- Added changelog window into the game
- Completed missions and achievements are announced in chat now

Bugs

- Fixed bug when multikills didn't reset after your death
- Fixed fatal bug when the game used wrong timer for synchronization of multiplayer
- Fixed bug when bots didn't change their weapon
- Fixed bug when detonation sometimes didn't detonate all explosives
- Fixed bug when you sometimes could have heard sound of steps
- Fixed bug with localization 'sensitivity of mouse' (finally)
- Fixed bug of some annoying errors while creating the game
- Fixed bug of functionality of global leaderboards
- Hundreds of small bug fixes

notes.title: Patch notes 0.6.0
notes.notes:
https://trello-attachments.s3.amazonaws.com/5719ebc6437eeaa9086506e3/1920x1080/a431c2d0ee2c1520eafd1ec8cc98d07b/GM_PN_0.6.png
Graphics
- Added various colors of power-ups 
    They are now divided to categories:

        Blue - Active power-up
        Purple - Passive power-up
        Orange - Rare power-up
        Green  - Health Box
        Red - Debuff (negative power-up)
        Grey - Others (Experience Box)


- New model for barrel
- New model for taser
- New model for knife
- Model of granades is now 2,5x bigger and should glow more
- When your power-up slots are full, they shake a little when you try to pick up another one (passive stack power-up as well)
- Added stack of passive power-ups (on the left of screen)
- Achievement notification is now displayed in chat


Gameplay
- Rate of Fire of grenades reworked
      * You can fire all your grenades at (almost) once
* Cooldown between shots is 0,1s
* Grenade launcher stack refills right after the grenade explodes.
* Time before explosion is ticking after the sticking the grenade on surface not after launching

- Added Holy Grenade power-up
* Sticky type grenade
* Time before explosion 2,5s
* Holy Grenade has got infinite blast range
* If you are within an angle of explosion you get killed by HG
* If you are within an angle of explosion the indicator shows you are in danger zone of HG
* If you die with power-up you will loose it

- Time before grenade explosion is now 1,85s from 1,5s
- Smoke Grenade has 2s cooldown to refill now instead of waiting when the smoke ends
- Added a collision for grenade explosions
* Now you can safely hide behind the crate or the wall without being hit by grenade (It Should have been done months ago)

- Complete rework of power-up probability drops
- Removed Barrel Gun (merged into the Crate Gun after picking a Gun Upgrade power-up)
- Added Gun Upgrade power-up
* Allows you to place barrels with Crate Gun (Right Mouse Button)
* Adds a sight to Grenade Launcher

- Removed Time Speed Up power-up (replaced by Quick Explosions)
- Added Quick Explosions (max 5 stacks)
* shorts time before explosion by 0,4s (max 1,7s)
* Applies on every sticky type grenade (even on Holy Grenade - max 2,0s reduction)

- Fast Run is now a passive ability - increases movement speed by 10% (it can stack by 10% each)
- Increased pick up radius of power-up
- Power-ups can be destroyed by grenades now
- If you die you will loose 1 stack of every power-up now
- Movement speed while you have melee weapon in hand has been reduced. It's the same as grenade launcher now.
- Added Top secret Achievement

Sounds
- Sound when you pick up a power-up was removed

Technical
- Added DOF setting

Bugfixes
- Fixed the incorrect power-up drops probabilities calculations
- Fixed bug whenpower-ups didn't have random positions to spawn
- Fixed bug when you may stuck in loading screen
- Fixed bug when you were able to have permanent power-ups after reconnecting to another server
- Fixed bug when you can get infinite ammo
- Fixed bug when you can't respawn when host leaved the game
- Fixed bug when sounds didn't apply user settings after second launch
- Fixed bug when some crates had been destroyed unintentionally sometimes
- Fixed bug when sometimes crates has been desynchronized between host and players
- Fixed bug that bots can't pick up power-ups
- Fixed bug with tiles in winter arena
- Fixed bug when sometimes crates got wrongly synchronized in skycraper arena

notes.title: Patch notes 0.5.3
notes.notes:
http://cdn.grenademadness.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/RgPwyTC.png

We’ve spent the last week date tuning up the gameplay, to make the game more fun and enjoyable. As we are getting feedback from players and youtubers, we focused on several important things.


Graphics
- Added spawn animation of crates with blue color effect
- Added animation of progress bars (Missions, Experience, etc)
- Noise over the screen with low HP is more visible now

Technical
- Number of players in game increased from 4 to 8 - The true madness's raising (ssssss BOOM)
- Number of bots in game increased from 4 to 8
- Removed limitation of "1 mission per game" (Now if you complete the mission, you'll get another right after that)
- In mission menu is now showed reward for individual mission
- Increased mouse sensitivity
- Game now will by default launch in fullscreen mode and with fantastic graphics settings

Sounds
- Flash grenade sound is a bit louder

Gameplay
- Slowdown powerup time duration reduced from 15s to 7,5s
- Barrels have increased radius of explosion (+100%) and damage (+100%) - It's much more dangerous!
- Spawn rate of barrels increased by 2%
- Frag grenade explodes after 3rd bounce (makes completely different weapon, try out that!)
- Some of missions give Madness Points as a reward. This is in test phase so it could be completely changed in future

Bugfixes
- Some adjustments of timestep physics that should prevent from walking throught the walls in specific cases.
- Repaired bug when players stayed near to eachother and killed themselves at once and then they couldn't respawn
